## Introduction to Project Section

The Projects section is a crucial part of any portfolio website that shows your practical work and the skills you've applied in real-world projects.

The design of the Project section is shown below:

![Design of the Project Section](data:image/png;base64,)

Each project will be displayed as a card element, similar to the Blog section.

Let's start by creating the card layout for each project.
